hook: KMeans on Apple silicon, twenty to thirty-one times faster.
hookText: KMeans much faster on Apple silicon

beats.say: mlx-learn 0.1.6 is out, and its KMeans with the default k-means-plus-plus initialization now fits twenty to thirty-one times faster on Apple silicon.
On an M4 Max, fitting 8,192 centers on MNIST took 219 seconds in version 0.1.5, and just 7 seconds in 0.1.6.
Nothing else changed: the same starting centers as scikit-learn, the same iterations, and the same inertia, and the release is out now.
